## P19-T16 — ordinary doctor contract fixture repair

Parent #51; discovered by the P17 ordinary serial gate at e960b2c. EWP-CMD-DOCTOR-TS03/TS05 has six failures because the child fixture inherits host PATH and detects multiple real Codex installations. The pair-equivalence selector also fails on unchanged 5a74185 (0 pass/1 fail), proving it predates the carry-forward.

- [ ] Give the doctor child a fixture-owned executable path containing only the required real Git/Bun tools; retain explicit per-case overrides.
- [ ] Keep exact findings, repair and human-output expectations unchanged.
- [ ] Re-run the full doctor owner, normal static/smoke and serial terminal gates.
- [ ] Record review/integration evidence.

This is test reliability within non-publication closeout, not a waiver of the gate. Do not remove host tools or change production discovery to make tests pass.

### Related baseline failure: EWP-CMD-VERIFY-TS04

At d0ea2f4 the ordinary gate passed doctor and update, then failed verify TS04: an empty PATH still discovers the inherited user's Codex under HOME, returning exit 0 instead of expected 4. The same selector fails on untouched 5a74185 (0 pass/1 fail). Isolate HOME, XDG and tool configuration in this fixture too; retain the original invocation, exit, JSON target and stderr assertions. Full verify owner now passes 15 tests/80 assertions; final terminal gate and review remain required. P19-T16 owns both related fixture failures.
